import json
import signal
import sys
from urllib.parse import unquote
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait, Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

settings = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
driver = None

def deadline(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError('Search browser proof exceeded 25 seconds')

signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, deadline)
signal.alarm(25)
try:
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
    options.binary_location = '/usr/bin/chromium'
    for option in ['--headless=new', '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--window-size=1280,960']:
        options.add_argument(option)
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=options)
    driver.set_page_load_timeout(8)
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 6)
    driver.get(settings['url'])
    name, value = settings['cookie'].split('=', 1)
    driver.add_cookie({'name': name, 'value': value, 'path': '/'})
    driver.get(settings['url'] + '/?browser-fixture=authenticated#/search?orgId=' + settings['orgId'])
    driver.execute_script("""
        window.__searchProof = {events: [], requests: []};
        const proof = window.__searchProof;
        proof.form = () => {
            const form = document.querySelector('.filter-form');
            return form ? {html: form.outerHTML, values: [...form.elements].map(item => ({tag: item.tagName,
                type: item.type, value: item.value, valid: item.validity?.valid, message: item.validationMessage,
                rect: item.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON()}))} : null;
        };
        for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointerup', 'click', 'focusin', 'submit', 'invalid']) {
            document.addEventListener(type, event => proof.events.push({type, tag: event.target.tagName,
                text: event.target.textContent?.slice(0, 100), value: event.target.value,
                active: document.activeElement?.outerHTML, form: proof.form()}), true);
        }
        const fetch = window.fetch;
        window.fetch = async (...args) => {
            const entry = {url: String(args[0]), method: args[1]?.method ?? 'GET', body: args[1]?.body};
            proof.requests.push(entry);
            try {const response = await fetch(...args); entry.status = response.status; return response;}
            catch (error) {entry.error = error.message; throw error;}
        };
    """)
    query = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-query"]')))
    query.send_keys('label:Sh')
    wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[role="listbox"] [role="option"]')) == 1)
    query.send_keys(Keys.ARROW_DOWN)
    query.send_keys(Keys.ENTER)
    wait.until(lambda browser: query.get_attribute('value') == 'label:"Ship today"')
    query.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    query.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    query.send_keys('project:FIND AND (priority>=3 OR status:__absent__)')
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-submit"]'))).click()
    result_selector = '[data-testid="search-result-' + settings['issueId'] + '"]'
    wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, result_selector)))
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//summary[normalize-space()="Build a compound query with fields and groups"]').click()
    root = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-builder .query-group')
    root.find_element(By.XPATH, './/button[normalize-space()="Add condition"]').click()
    condition = root.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-condition')
    Select(condition.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[0]).select_by_value('priority')
    wait.until(lambda browser: any(option.text == '>=' for option in browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-condition select:nth-of-type(1) option')) or any(option.text == '>=' for option in browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-condition option')))
    condition = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-condition')
    Select(condition.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[1]).select_by_visible_text('>=')
    condition.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'input').send_keys('3')
    wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-builder code').text == '(priority>=3)')
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Apply and search"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: query.get_attribute('value') == '(priority>=3)')
    wait.until(lambda browser: '(priority>=3)' in browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'section[aria-label="Search results"] code').text)
    query.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    query.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    query.send_keys('"<script>"')
    wait.until(lambda browser: '"<script>"' in unquote(browser.find_element(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Link to this query').get_attribute('href')))
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-submit"]'))).click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, result_selector + ' mark')) > 0)
    assert len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results script')) == 0
    assert not driver.execute_script('return Boolean(window.__searchInjected)')
    query.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    query.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    query.send_keys('Keyboard')
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Save search"]').click()
    name_input = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input')))
    name_input.send_keys('Browser saved query')
    driver.execute_script('window.__searchProof.beforeSave = window.__searchProof.form()')
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//form[contains(@class,"filter-form")]//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: 'Saved “Browser saved query”.' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
    print(json.dumps({'saveDiagnostic': driver.execute_script('return window.__searchProof')}), file=sys.stderr)
    pause = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Pause updates"]')
    pause.click()
    wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Resume updates"]')))
    def api(method, path, body=None):
        return driver.execute_async_script("""
            const [method,path,body,done]=arguments;
            fetch('/api/v1'+path,{method,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','X-Crew-Request':'1'},body:body==null?undefined:JSON.stringify(body)})
              .then(async response=>done({status:response.status,data:await response.json()}))
              .catch(error=>done({error:error.message}));
        """, method, path, body)
    stored = api('GET', '/filters?orgId=' + settings['orgId'])['data']['items']
    saved_filter = next(item for item in stored if item['name'] == 'Browser saved query')
    assert saved_filter['query'] == 'Keyboard'
    driver.get(settings['url'] + '/?browser-fixture=filters#/filters?orgId=' + settings['orgId'])
    edit = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Edit"]')))
    edit.click()
    name_input = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input')))
    name_input.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    name_input.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    name_input.send_keys('Local draft name')
    changed = api('PATCH', '/filters/' + saved_filter['id'], {'name': 'External revision', 'expectedRevision': 1})
    assert changed['status'] == 200
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//form[contains(@class,"filter-form")]//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').click()
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Inspect latest saved version"]'))).click()
    wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'aside[aria-label="Latest saved filter"]')))
    assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value') == 'Local draft name'
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Load latest saved version"]').click()
    wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept()
    wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value') == 'External revision')
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//form[contains(@class,"filter-form")]//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: 'Saved “External revision”.' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
    revised = api('GET', '/filters/' + saved_filter['id'])
    assert revised['data']['filter']['revision'] == 3
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Edit"]'))).click()
    name_input = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input')))
    name_input.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    name_input.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    name_input.send_keys('Retained after access loss')
    assert api('DELETE', '/filters/' + saved_filter['id'])['status'] == 200
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//form[contains(@class,"filter-form")]//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: 'no longer editable with your current access' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
    assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value') == 'Retained after access loss'
    assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//form[contains(@class,"filter-form")]//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').is_enabled()
    print(json.dumps({'keyboardCompletion': True, 'compoundResults': True, 'escapedHighlight': True, 'savedFilter': True,
        'livePause': True, 'typedBuilder': True, 'staleConflict': True, 'accessLossCustody': True}))

except Exception:
    if driver:
        print(json.dumps({'browserUrl': driver.current_url, 'body': driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text[:12000], 'logs': driver.get_log('browser'), 'builderHtml': driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-builder').get_attribute('innerHTML') if driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-builder') else '', 'searchRequests': driver.execute_script("return performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(item=>item.name.includes('/search?')).map(item=>item.name)"), 'queryValue': driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-query"]').get_attribute('value') if driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-query"]') else '', 'saveDiagnostic': driver.execute_script('return window.__searchProof'), 'resultHtml': driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results').get_attribute('innerHTML') if driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results') else ''}), file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver:
        driver.quit()
